data.name: Iftikhaari
data.gender_notes: Iftikhaari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who does and fulfills promises; Able, Capable, Powerful. The name Iftikhaari carries the meaning “Doer, Able, Capable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Iftikhaari usually hope their child will grow to embody doer, able, capable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Expressing gratitude and fulfilling promises to Allah (SWT)
data.etymology: Iftikhaari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Doer, Able, Capable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iftikhaari total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_english.name: Iftikhaari
in_english.meaning: High reputation and esteem, great glory and respect
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iftikhaari is derived from the Arabic root verb IF-Ḫ-R, meaning high reputation and esteem, great glory and respect, and is often given to children, especially boys, as it reflects the qualities of difficulty, patience, and competence. This personality type is often associated with high achievements and great ambitions, and is often chosen by parents who wish to instill in their child a strong sense of self-worth and confidence.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Iftikhaar" signifies a strong sense of responsibility and commitment towards promises made. In the Islamic culture, this name instills a sense of pride and honor in one's ability to keep their word and fulfill obligations towards others. It sets a high standard for individuals to be reliable, trustworthy, and dependable in their actions. This name also celebrates the power and ability of every individual to make a positive impact on their community and the world around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Iftikhaar" holds a deeper spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It serves as a reminder of the importance of fulfilling the promises made to Allah and living according to the teachings of the Quran and the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This name reflects the belief that every individual has the power and ability to serve Allah through their actions and choices. It encourages individuals to strive for excellence in their faith, character, and service to humanity. Ultimately, the name "Iftikhaar" is a call to be God-conscious, capable, and committed individuals who use their abilities to make a positive impact on the world and bring about goodness and blessings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Doer, Able, Capable" symbolizes One who does and fulfills promises; Able, Capable, Powerful. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Iftikhaari serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of doer, able, capable.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture
